messages.subject: St. Andrews distance sampling workshops beginning in two months
messages.subject_clean: St. Andrews distance sampling workshops beginning in two months
messages.body_plain:
Training workshops in distance sampling (introductory and advanced) will
begin in just under two months at St. Andrews.  We still have some
places available on both the introductory and advanced workshops.  Visit
the workshop website
(http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance.workshops/distance2013/workshop_overview.html)
for further details.  Early registration deadline is less than a month
away (19 July).

As a reminder, we are teaching automated survey design and the use of
covariates in detection functions as part of the introductory workshop.
These topics previously were taught in the advanced workshop.

In the advanced workshop this year we will showcase a number of R
packages we have developed to deal with special analytical problems.  In
particular we will be demonstrating a simulation engine for distance
sampling where contrasting survey designs can be compared.  We will also
be describing new R software for dealing with intermittent availability
[see Langrock et al. in forthcoming J. Am. Stat. Assoc.
http://amstat.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/01621459.2013.797356#.UcMgI5whGt8]
and also an R package for estimation in the presence of a density
gradient within the truncation distance [see Cox et al. Methods in
Ecology & Evolution
http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/2041-210X.12058/abstract]. If
you have these issues in your data, consider attending the advanced
workshop.

--
Eric Rexstad
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
University of St. Andrews
St. Andrews Scotland KY16 9LZ
